sup:70110.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

For generations, our foundry has taken great pride in supplying our regional partners with the utmost care and quality. To continue serving you with the craftsmanship you expect from us, we must account for our rising expenses. Over the past twelve months, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost.

Taking these developments into consideration, we are pleased to present our offer for a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We value our long-standing relationship deeply and look forward to continuing our successful cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

reply.text:
Guten Tag,

It is always a pleasure to reflect on the long-standing relationship our foundry has shared with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH over the years. We take immense pride in the craftsmanship of our people and the high-quality castings we deliver from our region.

Regarding our current Angebot, we are offering a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. Please keep in mind that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

Without movement from your side we cannot move either. We value our partnership deeply and hope we can find a good way forward together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.subject: Re: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
move.body:
Dear Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG team,

You have reminded us that you previously held prices steady, and it sounds like you want that support reciprocated rather than taken for granted. We value that partnership and want a fair adjustment grounded in current cost drivers that also supports your cash flow. How could faster payment help us agree a proportionate adjustment and a workable transition?

We confirm a binding volume of 8,150 units per year for 12 months. Using your own cost shares (LCI-C 30%, PPI-C241 24%) and the latest six-month index moves (LCI-C +1.7%, PPI-C241 +6.2%), your cost increase comes to about +2.0% of the price, not +9.5%. Straight talk: over the last 12 months we paid 86% of your invoices late, on average 3 days after the due date. That is on us, and it ends with this contract: every invoice paid on the due date, which brings your cash in about 3 days earlier than you are used to.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 127.31 per unit, from 2027-01-01, 14 days payment). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We appreciate your candidness regarding past payment delays and welcome the proposed 14-day terms alongside the binding volume. Your cost calculation applies six-month index movements, whereas our actual cost burden reflects the full twelve-month increases; please provide the source for your figures. 

In the spirit of our long-standing partnership, we accept the delayed effective date of 1 January 2027 and the 14-day payment terms at a revised price of €136.80 per unit. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. 

For our offer, we present a price of €136.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 January 2027. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.body:
Dear Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG team,

You welcome faster payment while questioning the index basis—it sounds like payment certainty and a shared understanding of your actual costs both matter. We value the partnership and want to recognise justified cost increases while making on-time payment dependable. How can we reconcile your annual cost movements with the verified annual energy data below to establish a sustainable adjustment?

We confirm a binding volume of 8,150 units per year for 12 months. Using your own cost shares (LCI-C 30%, PPI-C241 24%) and the latest six-month index moves (LCI-C +1.7%, PPI-C241 +6.2%), your cost increase comes to about +2.0% of the price, not +9.5%.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 128.04 per unit, from 2027-01-01, 14 days payment). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your slight movement, but your calculation still relies on six-month index data while our actual cost burden reflects the full twelve-month increases. You mentioned verified annual energy data in your message, but none was provided; please share this data so we can review it.

Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. However, in recognition of our partnership and your commitment to 14-day payment terms, we can offer a further adjusted price of €136.10 per unit. 

For complete clarity, our offer stands at a price of €136.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 January 2027. Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

We value our long-standing relationship with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and look forward to continuing our work together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.subject: Re: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
move.body:
Dear Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG team,

You have linked your further concession to prompt payment and our partnership—it sounds like recognising each other’s contribution matters to you. We value that reciprocity and are providing the verified annual electricity producer-price data below, while respecting the confidentiality of your costing. How can we use this evidence and payment certainty to agree a fair adjustment that supports our long-term partnership?

We confirm a binding volume of 8,150 units per year for 12 months. Using your own cost shares (LCI-C 30%, PPI-C241 24%) and the latest six-month index moves (LCI-C +1.7%, PPI-C241 +6.2%), your cost increase comes to about +2.0% of the price, not +9.5%. What is the lowest price at which you can sign these terms today?

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 128.74 per unit, from 2027-01-01, 14 days payment). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We do not disclose our internal limits, but in the interest of our long-standing partnership, we are prepared to make a further concession. Our margin and our limits stay internal, and our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. We offer a price of €135.50 per unit, maintaining the 14-day payment terms and the 1 January 2027 effective date. For your records, our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. 

To help you plan, please note that our offer stays valid for 7 days. Our team here in the foundry takes great pride in the quality we deliver to Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, and we sincerely hope to continue our successful collaboration.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
